content.title: Film Preview: The Bus Boy — WINERY REFLECTIONS
content.text: No results found. Menu View fullsize Attitude is everything - just ask Bobby Stuckey. Over the course of his distinguished career in hospitality Bobby has accomplished nearly anything a service professional could dream of, from passing the Master Sommelier exam to winning multiple James Beard awards and even opening his very own restaurants, and he has done it all with a smile on his face despite oft-arduous circumstances. The Bus Boy, a short film directed by Andrew Ackerman, examines the life and career of Bobby Stuckey from his time as a punk rock teenage bus boy to his ascent in becoming an accomplished restaurateur and one of the world's most influential sommeliers. This positive, engaging, feel-good picture is an anthem for underdogs everywhere, cheerfully proving through Bobby's incredible life story that unrelenting drive and a can-do attitude are keys to success for even the most unlikely of heroes. Whether it is gourmet dining, fine wine, or simply a fascinating narrative that tickles your fancy, be sure to catch this charming and thoroughly captivating short film on Somm TV.
